Measured hybrid_confirmed=False (duplicate_class_count=5).
falsifiable_test.hybrid_worse_if: J(hybrid) > J(best_single) on lexicographic (duplicate_class_count, split_brain_drift), correctness first. Measured: J(hybrid_split)=[5, 2] vs J(best_single)=[0, 0].
falsifiable_test.measurement: duplicate_class_count from the parser on the composed table; split_brain_drift = |A1 loaded skill ids symmetric-difference A2 registry skill ids| on the split fixture.
falsifiable_test.objective_function: Program objective function (catalog ARC-0002 / _USER-PROMPTS.md:10487-10498): correctness first and resource efficiency last. Duplicate control planes are a correctness failure (spec 10483). J = (duplicate_class_count, split_brain_drift); lower is better.

named_pair.justification: Adjacent skills rows in the composed table name A1-manifest-loader and A2-ssot-generator as two authorities for the same class. Skills are the class operators add most often; each new skill must be entered on both planes, so the plane the operator remembers first becomes the real control plane over time.

negative_controls.description: A1-only table must be singular; maximal union must duplicate skills authority.
Dropping defect_locus from a REFUTED claim must fail the overclaim checker; the intact artifact must pass.

question: Refute the maximal hybrid: argue that 'maximal' is precisely how duplicate control planes get built, identify the SPECIFIC pair of subsystems most likely to grow overlapping ownership over time, and state the falsifiable test that would show the hybrid is worse than the best single architecture on the program's own objective function.

retry.policy: Two same-fingerprint structural refutes park BLOCKED with a named required_fix. No ADV rebuild of A9 DESIGN.json. Catalog shim $ref is not retried onto the network.

reviewer.method: Mechanical scope check: every REFUTED row has defect_locus in {DESIGN, SENTENCE}; at least one CONFIRMED row exists; dossier and live-tree anchors resolve; named pair cites adjacent table rows; falsifiable test states the CONFIRM outcome. Agreement with REFUTED is not required. Author objection alone cannot flip REFUTED.

scenario.catching_architecture: A2 generated-SSOT as a singular plane: REGISTRY.json is the only skills authority, so a second A1 MANIFEST skip cannot silently omit a generated skill and cannot silently keep a skill the registry never named.
scenario.on_this_estate: A9/DESIGN.json is absent on this worktree and is not rebuilt. The composed table is extracted from live A1 and A2 DESIGN.json file_set rows under the catalog maximal-from-each rule.
procedure: 1. Extract capability-to-authority rows from A1 DESIGN.json file_set (authority=A1-manifest-loader) and A2 DESIGN.json file_set (authority=A2-ssot-generator).
2. Sort by (capability, authority). Adjacent skills rows name both authorities for the same class.
3. Detector: group by capability; FAIL if any class has two authorities. A1-only and A2-only PASS; maximal union FAIL-CLOSES on skills/hooks/rules/workflows/council.
4. Split fixture: A1 MANIFEST loads skill.listed; A2 REGISTRY has skill.council. Symmetric-difference drift >= 1. A1 unlisted skip remains silent (no error, no warning).
5. Agree fixture: both planes carry skill.council. Drift = 0, detector still FAIL-CLOSED (consistency is not singularity).
6. Compare J=(dup, drift) against the best single (min of A1-only, A2-only). Hybrid is worse. CONFIRM would require J(hybrid) < J(best_single).
scenario.title: Maximal union of A1 MANIFEST and A2 REGISTRY duplicates skills authority

scope.not_refuted: A selective hybrid that assigns exactly one authority per capability class can still pass the singularity detector.
scope.this_composition: maximal-from-each: union of live A1 MANIFEST loader, A2 SSOT generator, and A6 vendor adapter, which is the catalog ARC-0059 rule applied to dossiers that exist on this worktree.

singularity_detector.method: Parse file_set roles from live DESIGN.json dossiers; map role to capability class; group by capability; FAIL if |authorities|>1. A prose singularity sentence is not evidence.

strongest_surviving_counterargument: A hybrid that assigns exactly one authority per capability class can still be singular: keep A2's REGISTRY for skills/hooks/rules/workflows/council and keep A6's negotiation for vendor-tools, and drop the A1 MANIFEST as a second existence plane. That is a selective composition, not the maximal 'strongest from each' union. The surviving claim is therefore: composition is allowed when the capability-to-authority table has one authority per row; maximal-from-each is the construction that violates that gate.
